fn wechat_media::inspect_video_container | fn(input: &[u8]) -> anyhow::Result<&'static str> | Check the top-level movie boxes before invoking the MOV-family demuxer. Older QuickTime movies may omit `ftyp`; both layouts still need owned movie metadata and media bytes. This only checks container structure; callers must separately decode and validate streams before sending.

mod wechat_media | - | Bounded media inspection shared by native transport and official profiles. Source bytes, including application trailers, are never rewritten here. WXGF inspection decodes a representative still only. Its animation timing, frame count and alpha semantics remain unknown; the original stays WXGF.
